title: Lord Iveagh
html_source: Lord Iveagh was chief executive of the Guinness company until 1889, subsequently becoming the chairman of the board, running the largest brewery in the world.

anchor.prefix:
shreds fluttered away, sank in the dank air: a white flutter, then all sank. 

 Henry Flower. You could tear up a cheque for a hundred pounds in the same way. Simple bit of paper.
anchor.suffix: once cashed a sevenfigure cheque for a million in the bank of Ireland. Shows you the money to be made out of porter. Still the other brother lord Ardilaun has to change his shirt
